DEFINE.core_strategy: Extend single-file inspection to report both measures on every successful invocation, accepting a breaking output change while preserving the existing invocation, word-count semantics and specified error behavior.

rejected_alternatives.direction: Make character reporting optional while retaining the existing default output.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Would preserve existing consumers by default, but conflicts with the requirement to report both counts every time and add no flags.

rejected_alternatives.direction: Offer character counting through a separate command or invocation.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids changing existing output, but requires users to take an additional action and does not provide both measures through the existing invocation.

rejected_alternatives.direction: Report a byte count instead of a Unicode code-point count.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: May be simpler for consumers concerned with file size, but misrepresents non-ASCII text and fails the requested character definition.

dependencies.description: Approval of an updated specification that supersedes SPEC-0001's successful-output requirement while retaining its unaffected requirements.
Approval of architecture changes to reflect character-count ownership and the expanded command and system responsibilities.
Access to the existing regression suite and four required Quality Gate checks.
dependencies.status: Available per project handoff; execution pending

assumptions.description: Whitespace for character exclusion follows the same text whitespace semantics used by the existing word rule, including spaces, tabs and newlines.
assumptions.how_checked: Confirm the interpretation in the updated specification and check representative Unicode whitespace and non-whitespace examples.
assumptions.if_false: Resolve the intended whitespace definition before finalizing the specification.

assumptions.description: The intentional output break is acceptable for existing consumers without a compatibility mode.
assumptions.how_checked: Review affected consumer expectations and approve the changed output contract.
assumptions.if_false: Reopen the no-flags and always-combined-output constraints before proceeding.

risks.description: Consumers expecting a bare integer may fail or misinterpret the new output.
risks.mitigation: Clearly document the changed contract and communicate it to known consumers before release.

risks.description: Unicode and whitespace edge cases may yield misleading character counts.
risks.mitigation: Validate representative non-ASCII, whitespace-only and combining-character cases against the agreed definition.

risks.description: The output change or related work may inadvertently alter existing error or argument behavior.
risks.impact: Existing scripts and users experience unexpected failures or diagnostics.
risks.mitigation: Retain regression coverage for the approved invocation, error messages and exit statuses.

DEFINE.thesis: Provide users both word and non-whitespace Unicode character counts in one invocation now, while making the intentional output compatibility break explicit.

goals.description: Provide both requested text measures on every successful single-file inspection.
goals.why: Users currently receive only the word count and cannot obtain the requested character measure from the command.
goals.success_metric: 100% of representative successful-invocation tests produce the exact combined output with correct counts.

goals.description: Preserve existing invocation, word semantics and specified failure behavior.
goals.why: The requested enhancement changes successful output, not the command interface or error contract.
goals.success_metric: 100% of applicable approved invocation, word-count and error regression checks pass.

success_criteria.criterion: Successful output reports both counts in the required format.
success_criteria.measurement: Successful-invocation tests covering ordinary, empty and whitespace-only UTF-8 files.
success_criteria.target: 100% pass; each successful invocation emits one line in the format `words: <N> characters: <M>`.
success_criteria.baseline: SPEC-0001 specifies a bare integer, so its successful-output contract does not match the new format.
success_criteria.cadence: Every change and Quality Gate run

success_criteria.criterion: Character counts represent non-whitespace Unicode code points rather than UTF-8 bytes.
success_criteria.measurement: Character-count and command tests including `café`, whitespace and combining characters.
success_criteria.baseline: SPEC-0001 does not report character counts.
success_criteria.cadence: Every change and Quality Gate run

success_criteria.criterion: Existing invocation, word counts and specified error behavior remain intact.
success_criteria.measurement: Applicable SPEC-0001 regression tests for arguments, word semantics, missing and unreadable files, invalid UTF-8 and traceback-free errors.
success_criteria.target: 100% pass, excluding the superseded bare-integer success-output expectation.
success_criteria.baseline: SPEC-0001 defines the existing behavior; current measured test results not supplied.
success_criteria.cadence: Every change and Quality Gate run

success_criteria.criterion: The required project Quality Gate remains satisfied.
success_criteria.measurement: Results of the four commands recorded in AGENTS.md.
success_criteria.target: All four commands exit 0 before the change lands.
success_criteria.baseline: Existing constitution requires all four checks; current run results not supplied.

non_goals.description: Preserve compatibility with clients that parse successful output as a bare integer.
non_goals.tradeoff: The mandated labeled combined line changes the existing success contract; no compatibility flag is allowed.

non_goals.description: Detect or reject binary files as a separate category.
non_goals.tradeoff: The approved specification requires invalid UTF-8 rejection, not binary detection; adding a new error behavior would expand the contract.

non_goals.description: Provide additional statistics, batch processing, standard-input processing or non-UTF-8 support.
non_goals.tradeoff: These capabilities extend beyond the requested single-file enhancement.

in_scope: Character counts for readable UTF-8 files, excluding whitespace and counting Unicode code points.
The exact combined successful-output contract for the existing single-path command.
Preservation of existing word-count, invocation and specified error behavior.
Documentation and regression coverage for the changed contract.
out_of_scope: Rebuilding the existing single-path command, word-count capability or specified error handling.
A compatibility mode, new flags or a separate invocation.
Binary detection as a new error behavior.
Additional text statistics, batch or standard-input processing, and non-UTF-8 file support.
Network access, persistent state, configuration files or third-party runtime dependencies.

walkthrough.name: Inspect a non-ASCII text file
today: A user invokes `wordcount PATH` for a readable UTF-8 file containing `café`.
The command reports `1` followed by a newline.
with_strategy: The user invokes the same `wordcount PATH` command without flags.
The command reports `words: 1 characters: 4` followed by a newline.
A consumer expecting only an integer must adapt to the new output.

walkthrough.name: Inspect a file that does not exist
today: The user supplies a nonexistent path.
The command writes the specified file-not-found line to stderr, writes nothing to stdout and exits with status 1.
with_strategy: The user supplies the same nonexistent path.
The existing specified error behavior remains unchanged; no counts are printed.

DISCOVER.Should whitespace characters, including: No. Exclude whitespace characters, including spaces, tabs and newlines.
DISCOVER.Should `wordcount PATH` always print bot: Always print both counts. Keep wordcount PATH; no new flags.
DISCOVER.If both counts are printed, what exact s: Single line, exactly like this example: words: 3 characters: 14 (word count first, then character count, both labeled).
